found_by: self-audit of the reserved result before reporting it
severity: MATERIAL: it changed a headline conclusion

defects.defect: The detector vocabulary included "authorised_review", which never occurs as an event source anywhere in the registry.
defects.consequence: It could only ever produce false positives, and did: it matched the phrase "authorised-review boundary", which comes from the release's own rule vocabulary and appears in any response invoking R01_REVIEW_BOUNDARY.
defects.evidence: Registry sources are exactly patient_report (320), support_record (440), administrative_record (200). authorised_review: 0.

defects.defect: The detector took a flat 80-character window either side of the identifier, with no clause boundary.
defects.consequence: A source named in an adjacent clause about a DIFFERENT record was attributed to this identifier. Worked example, CALL51-0000556: the window around EVT-0000114 (registry: support_record) caught "the latest administrative record does not resolve review status", a separate clause about a different record.
defects.sensitivity: The count is heuristic-dependent by a factor of four: 22 findings at window 80 with the old vocabulary, 20 with the corrected vocabulary, 14 with corrected vocabulary plus clause boundary, 5 at window 40.

changes: window truncated at the nearest sentence or clause boundary each side of the identifier
correction.not_changed: The 80-character span. Tightening it to 40 would have cut the count to 5, but that is arbitrary tuning rather than a correction, and arbitrary tuning is what this finding is about.

effect_on_the_result.plain_statement: The claim that the Qwen3 condition difference excluded zero against cognitive memory was an artefact of this detector. It does not survive the correction. The point estimate stays negative; the interval no longer excludes zero, so there is no statistically supported difference.

what_survives_unchanged: Two critical violations, both Qwen3, both on MEM51-0039, same defect: the returned rule cannot produce the returned reaction. Terra: none in 2,400 cases.

Cross-rendering instability: Qwen3 exact citation agreement 53.1% in B0 against 33.1% in B1, reaction agreement 76.2% against 68.1%. Terra flat at 91.9% / 91.2% and 95.6% / 95.6%. This check does not use the source detector at all.
Cognitive-trace coherence, partial prospective field stability 32/32, and the release-integrity result.
process_note: This is the second time a single heuristic check drove a headline against cognitive memory. The first was E4_INFLUENCE_UNEXPLAINED, demoted by decision A1. Any future single-check result in this audit should be assumed fragile until the per-code sensitivity has been run.
